title: Binary system period
description: Essential Criteria: Must derive or state the correct period formula T = 2π√[L³/(G(M+m))] for the two-body system.

title: Centripetal force equality
description: Important Criteria: Must apply Newton's second law to both masses, showing mω²r = Mω²R or equivalent force balance.

title: Geometric constraint
description: Important Criteria: Must use the condition r + R = L relating the orbital radii to the separation distance.

title: Simplified Earth-Moon period
description: Essential Criteria: Must correctly state the approximate period T₂ = 2π√(L³/(GM)) where M is Earth's mass.

title: Ratio of squared periods
description: Essential Criteria: Must compute (T₂/T₁)² = (M+m)/M and obtain the numerical value 1.012 (or 1.01 when rounded).

title: Mass ratio derivation
description: Important Criteria: Must solve for the individual orbital radii r and R in terms of m, M, and L.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Should verify dimensional consistency in period formulas (e.g., √[L³/(GM)] has time units).

title: Incorrect force expression
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize using F = GmM/r² or F = GmM/R² instead of F = GmM/L² for gravitational force.

title: Wrong center assumption
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize assuming one body is stationary or that both orbit the center of the heavier mass.
